#CodeRSA

This repository contains experiments for comparing LLM reranking methods 

* ** [View experiment conclusions](./analysis/conclusion.ipynb) 


## Experiment overview
* **[Random Selection] (./random_experiment)**
   * **Goal:** Out of the multiple code completions generated by the model we randomly select any three of them 
* **[Coder]**(./coder)
    * **Goal:** For each of the code completion we calculate the probability ,
        P(c/i) = Pllm (c/i)

    which is then used to rerank the code completions and the top three of them are selected
* **[CodeRSA]**(./CodeRSA)
    * **Goal:** Out of the multiple code completions genereated by the model we calculate the pragmatic speaker scores as 
        P(i/c) = P(c/i)/sum(P(c/i')) for all i'

    which is then used to rereank the code completion a nd the top three of them are selected

* **[CodeRSA_p_i]**(./RSA_p_i)
    * **Goal:** In the codeRSA experiment the term P(i)  was assumed to be constant .In this experiment using the fact that humans tend to write shorter prompts if the complexity of the problem is same I calculated the probability of the instructions based on their lenghts ,using a weighted average


## Conclusion and analysis 
A detailed analysis of the results from all experiments , including performance comparison and final conclusions is available in the main analysis notebook
